preamble: Replacement of the voiceless alveolar lateral fricative [ɬ] by the plain lateral approximant [l] (loss of frication plus voicing). The clearest documented cases are English adaptations of Welsh names, where Welsh ll [ɬ] is rendered as [l]. Welsh soft mutation ll → l is a morphological alternation and is not counted here.

examples.note: Surname borrowed from Welsh; the lateral fricative is replaced by English [l].
Given name borrowed from Welsh with [ɬ] rendered as [l].
